title: Best Cardio Workouts
meta_desc: Discover the best cardio workouts at NZ gyms, including treadmill, rowing, bike, and stair climber. Compare calorie burn and HIIT vs steady state training.
intro: Cardio exercises are a great way to improve your overall fitness and burn calories. With so many options available at NZ gyms, it can be hard to choose the best workout for your goals. In this guide, we'll compare the most popular cardio machines and provide tips on how to get the most out of your workout.

sections.heading: Introduction to Cardio Machines
sections.body: The most common cardio machines found in NZ gyms are treadmills, rowing machines, exercise bikes, and stair climbers. Each machine has its own unique benefits and calorie burn potential. For example, treadmills are great for running and walking, while rowing machines provide a full-body workout. Exercise bikes are low-impact and easy on the joints, while stair climbers are perfect for improving leg strength and endurance.
list: Treadmill: running, walking, and incline training
Rowing machine: full-body workout and low-impact
Exercise bike: low-impact and easy on the joints
Stair climber: leg strength and endurance

sections.heading: Calorie Burn Comparison
sections.body: The calorie burn potential of each machine varies depending on the intensity and duration of your workout. Generally, rowing machines and treadmills tend to burn the most calories, followed by exercise bikes and stair climbers. However, it's essential to remember that calorie burn also depends on individual factors such as weight, fitness level, and workout intensity.

sections.heading: HIIT vs Steady State Training
sections.body: When it comes to cardio training, there are two main approaches: High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) and steady state training. HIIT involves short bursts of high-intensity exercise followed by brief periods of rest, while steady state training involves maintaining a consistent pace throughout your workout. Both methods have their benefits, and the best approach for you will depend on your fitness goals and preferences.
list: HIIT: improved cardiovascular fitness, increased calorie burn, and enhanced insulin sensitivity
Steady state training: improved cardiovascular fitness, increased endurance, and reduced risk of injury

sections.heading: Best NZ Gyms for Cardio Training
sections.body: Some NZ gym chains offer better cardio equipment and facilities than others. City Fitness and Les Mills are known for their high-quality cardio machines and group fitness classes, while Jetts and Anytime Fitness provide a more affordable and flexible option. Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme can also help make cardio training more accessible and affordable for Kiwis.
list: City Fitness: high-quality cardio machines and group fitness classes
Les Mills: variety of cardio classes and modern equipment
Jetts: affordable and flexible cardio training options
Anytime Fitness: convenient locations and range of cardio equipment

sections.heading: Get Started with Cardio Training
sections.body: Now that you know the best cardio workouts and machines, it's time to get started. Remember to always consult with a doctor or fitness professional before beginning any new exercise programme. Start with short sessions and gradually increase the duration and intensity as you become more comfortable.
